label: context.reference
text:
Image generation is reached through world_image_generation: the image generation of the user's ChatGPT plan, through the ChatGPT sign-in on this Mac. Call image.generate with the complete prompt and, when they matter, size, quality and transparent_background. It runs without asking the operator. Its image.operation.result shows you the image itself as media; result.image gives its MIME type and byte count, and result.size and result.quality report what the service produced. Generation takes up to a few minutes and counts against the plan's image usage: make one call per image, wait for its result, and do not repeat a call that is still running.

Judge and describe the image you received, not the one you asked for. If it misses the request, improve the prompt and generate again only while that serves what the user asked.

When ok is false, error.code says why. account_sign_in_required, account_sign_in_expired or account_sign_in_unreadable: tell the user to sign in to ChatGPT in Octopus. usage_limit_reached: the plan's image allowance is used up until error.resets_at (Unix seconds); tell the user instead of retrying. authorization_refused: this ChatGPT account cannot generate images, for example on the Free plan. request_refused: the service declined this request, and error.message says why; correct what it names, changing the prompt only within what the user asked. indeterminate_external_effect: Octopus stopped while the image was being created, so it was lost and may still count against the plan's image usage; it was not requested again, so call again only if the image is still needed. rate_limited, service_unavailable or transport_failed: retry later. invalid_arguments: correct the call.
